dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are distributed along the lateral torso. The perimeter edges of these structures are irregular and exhibit a soft gradient transition from high-intensity black exterior fur to mid-intensity grey interiors. Most prominent are two vertically stacked annuli forming a figure-eight geometry and a series of smaller, less-defined arcs situated anteriorly.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of isolated, solid-color high-intensity pixel clusters. These blobs are localized primarily in the dorsal-midline region, lacking internal gradients and appearing as punctate, asymmetrical markers distinct from the larger ring patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central figure-eight structure, the adjacent elongated annulus to its lower left, and a small high-intensity blob directly dorsal to them form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of three smaller annuli further anterior forms a roughly equilateral triangular relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a vertically oriented, overlapping double-annulus configuration resembling a numeral '8' located in the mid-lateral field, which serves as the most visually distinct topological feature.
